name: Lulu AI Wingwoman
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a dating, matchmaking or AI companion app. Instrument Serif headlines with words picked out in a heavy sans, on pale pink lit by hot pink glows. Round portraits on colour discs circle the first screenshot, then white phones stand on a neon glow while chrome lips, pearl hearts, a crush alert, a profiles card and suggested first lines pop off the screens. Every part sits in named, editable layer groups, with each glow and each disc colour on a layer of its own.
